u0: Start of the episode or after losing the key: the ball still blocks the door cell and the agent does not hold the matching door key. Next objective: move the ball away from the door (pick it up) to reach u1, or pick up the matching key first to enter the key-first branch u4.
u1: The blocker is moved and the agent holds no matching key; progress is towards the key. Next objective: pick up the matching door key to advance to u2, while avoiding dropping the key while the door is still closed.
u2: The agent holds the matching door key and the blocker is moved; the door is still closed. Next objective: stand in front of the door and toggle it open to reach u3, being careful not to lose the key (which would send the agent back to u1).
u3: The door is open and the agent is in position to reach the target room. Next objective: go through the door and pick up the mission-designated box to finish at u6.
u4: The agent picked up the matching key before moving the ball; the blocker is still in front of the door. Next objective: move the blocking ball to advance to u2, but avoid dropping the key while the door is closed, which incurs a penalty and returns to u0.
u5: Unreachable sink state with no outgoing progress transitions; no useful subgoal is available here.
u6: The mission's target box has been picked up; the episode is complete and this terminal state persists with no further objective.
